# .github/workflows/

GitHub Actions pipelines: scheduled ingestion (cron), CI (tests/lint on PRs), and eventually deploy workflows. See `URBAN_PULSE_PROJECT_PLAN.md` Phase 1 Step 8 for a starter ingestion workflow. Name workflow files by what they do, e.g. `ingest_transit.yml`, `ingest_energy.yml`, `ingest_weather.yml`, `ci.yml`.
